messages:
maria: dropped a small prototype for the trace drilldown header — decisions: where to surface export and how to word the CID helper. figma: https://figma.com/s/trace-export-mini

*tariq:* for incidents, quick export is handy. suggest a tiny icon (no heavy button) next to the kebab, plus an entry in the menu. icon must be a real <button> with an aria-label, not just decorative.

*sam:* agree. tab order matters: keep CID first. prefer tab order: CID -> more -> export so copying stays frictionless. also SR: focus should move to the drilldown heading on open.

*katie:* copy: "Copy full correlation ID" reads better than "Click to copy..." and is shorter. For the export tooltip, "Export trace bundle (zip)" is clear. avoid ambiguous "download" term.

*lina:* a11y: use `aria-live` polite for copy confirmations ("Correlation ID copied"), but do NOT vocalize the full ID. icon needs visible focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast for helper text.

*maria:* proposal:
- show icon-only export left of kebab + export in kebab
- aria-label on icon: "Export trace bundle (zip)"
- CID helper: "Copy full correlation ID" with tooltip preview on focus
- move focus to drilldown heading on open
- `aria-live` message: "Correlation ID copied"

*tariq:* add acceptance criteria: keyboard activation via Enter/Space; screen reader announces heading; icon label read correctly; helper contrast passes.

*design-bot:* checklist: keyboard focus order, aria-labels, focus management, aria-live present, contrast >= 4.5:1. Missing: reduced-motion handling for expand animations.

*maria:* i'll update the prototype and add reduced-motion respect. can someone run a quick VoiceOver/NVDA pass after i push?

*katie:* i'll run VoiceOver and post notes.

*sam:* i'll run NVDA and verify tab order.

*lina:* i'll check contrast and focus rings.

*design-bot:* thread will auto-archive in 10 days if no activity.
